faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How does the free save limit work?
faq.a1: Every item successfully saved counts as 1 (failed saves don't count). YouTube and Instagram Reels share the same monthly pool. The counter resets on the 1st of each month at UTC 00:00.
faq.a2: Yes. After cancelling you keep Pro access until the end of your current billing period, then automatically revert to Free. All your data is preserved — saves go back to 20/month and queries to 50/month.
faq.a3: All content is encrypted at rest (AES-256). AI summaries and tags are processed by Anthropic Claude. We don't use your content to train models, and data is purged from the LLM provider after 30 days.
faq.q4: Do I need to pay to browse public collections?
faq.a4: No. Browsing public collections is free for everyone. Forking (copying a collection into your own library) is a Pro feature.
faq.q5: Can I switch between monthly and yearly?
faq.a5: Yes. Upgrading from monthly to yearly prorates the difference. Downgrading from yearly to monthly refunds the remainder to your original payment method or as credit.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Garner ('we') collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use the Garner personal knowledge base service (web app and Chrome Extension). Using the service means you have read and understood this policy.
privacy.s1_body: Garner is an independent developer-operated service. For any privacy-related questions, please use the contact form at the bottom of this page. We aim to respond within 30 days.
privacy.s2_account_body: When you sign in via Google or GitHub OAuth, we receive your email address, display name, and avatar URL (handled by Supabase Auth).
privacy.s2_content_body: URLs, page titles, thumbnails, AI-generated summaries and tags, and semantic search vectors (embeddings) for items you save to your knowledge base. This data is processed on the basis of our contractual obligation to provide the service.
privacy.s2_analytics_body: We collect anonymized behavioral events (e.g. feature usage counts) via PostHog to understand how the product is used and improve it. IP addresses are anonymized before storage. We do not link these events to your account identity.
privacy.s2_errors_body: We use Sentry to collect exception errors and performance data to detect and fix issues. Error reports do not include your knowledge base content. IP addresses may be captured by Sentry for rate-limiting purposes.
privacy.s2_payment_body: Subscription transactions are handled entirely by Lemon Squeezy. We only store your subscription plan and status — no credit card or payment details are stored on our end.
privacy.s3_body: Content you save (web page text, YouTube video data) is sent to the following AI services for processing:
privacy.s3_li1: Summaries and tags: Anthropic Claude (via OpenRouter)
privacy.s3_li2: Semantic search vectors: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dimensions)
privacy.s3_note: We do not use your content to train any AI models. Temporary processing data is handled per each provider's data retention policy (see Section 5). Semantic vectors are stored in our own database and subject to the retention policy in Section 6.
privacy.s4_body: All user data is stored in Supabase PostgreSQL (AES-256 encryption at rest). Thumbnail cache is stored in Cloudflare R2 object storage. Servers are located in the United States. If you are located outside the US (including the EU/EEA), your data is transferred to and processed in the US. We rely on contractual protections with each provider to safeguard your data during such transfers.
privacy.s5_body: We use the following third-party services, each with their own privacy policies:
privacy.s6_body: We retain all data while your account is active. After you delete your account, all data is removed from our systems (including backups) within 30 days. Soft-deleted content (marked with deleted_at) is permanently purged after 90 days.
privacy.s7_body: You have the following rights over your personal data. To exercise any right, please use the contact form at the bottom of this page — we will respond within 30 days.
privacy.s7_li1: Access & export: export all your data in JSON format from the Settings page
privacy.s7_li2: Deletion: delete your account from the Settings page, or contact us
privacy.s7_li3: Correction: contact us to correct any inaccurate account information
privacy.s7_li4: Restriction: request that we pause processing your data while a dispute is resolved
privacy.s7_li5: Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interests
privacy.s7_li6: Complaint: if you are in the EU/EEA, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority
privacy.s8_body: Garner uses Supabase session tokens stored in localStorage to maintain your login state. PostHog may set first-party cookies (prefixed ph_) for session tracking; these are used solely for anonymized analytics and are not shared with advertisers. We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.s9_body: Garner is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 13. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.
privacy.s10_body: If we make significant changes to this policy, we will notify you by email at least 14 days before the changes take effect, or via an in-app notice. Continued use of the service after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s11_body: For any privacy-related questions, please use our contact form:

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: Thank you for subscribing to Garner. Please read our refund policy carefully before purchasing.
refund.s1_body: All subscription fees are non-refundable. We do not offer refunds for any plan, whether billed monthly or annually. This is because AI processing, storage, and compute costs are incurred as soon as a subscription begins.
refund.s2_body: You may cancel your subscription at any time from Settings → Billing — no reason required, no need to contact support. After cancellation, your paid features remain active until the end of the current billing period, after which your account reverts to the free plan.
refund.s3_body: We do not offer general refunds, but the following situations may be considered on a case-by-case basis: a technical failure that renders the service completely unusable for more than 72 hours, or a billing error such as a duplicate charge. If this applies to you, please submit a request within 14 days of the incident via our contact form with a brief description, and we will review it promptly.
refund.s4_body: Upgrades take effect immediately; any difference is charged on a pro-rated basis for the remaining days in your billing cycle. Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period — you retain access to your current plan until then, and no refund is issued for unused days.
